aggregate.uncertainty: Não há margem de erro agregada validada. Faixas de ±3 p.p. no painel são apenas ilustração.
aggregate.note: O painel calcula dinamicamente a média robusta a partir das 11 pesquisas mais recentes por instituto. O histórico legado é mantido sem recálculo e não é diretamente comparável.

recencyModel.referenceStatistic: leave-one-out median of candidate F valid vote shares
recencyModel.formula: raw_i = 2^(-ageDays_i/7) × min(1,2.5/abs(f_i - median(f_j for j != i))); normalize raw_i to 100%; mean = sum(weight_i × f_i)
recencyModel.policy: One latest round per institute; all polls with valid fieldEnd and candidate shares included; equal base weights; symmetric robust treatment regardless of favored candidate.
recencyModel.limitations: Experimental parameters, not backtested. No validated aggregated confidence interval. Historical mean remains legacy and is not directly comparable.
recencyModel.ageBasis: Last fieldwork day; fixed bulletin reference date, not visitor clock

standardModelLegacy.policy: Latest poll per institute; no automatic exclusion; no retrospective weight changes.

standardModelPreviousProvisional.policy: Latest confirmed national second-round poll per institute. 11 currently listed institutes; legacy MAEs retained as unverified, missing MAEs assigned explicit conservative proxy 5.0 pp, NOT measured error. Reaudit and replace proxy on documentary evidence.

weightAudit.penaltyRule: For institutes without a historical MAE in the legacy model, use a provisional 5.0 pp denominator in 1/(1+MAE), normalized across all included institutes. This is a disclosed modeling assumption, not measured historical accuracy.

standardModelBeforeRegularization.policy: All 11 current national second-round institutes, latest confirmed poll each. Existing first-round MAEs remain legacy unverified; for 6 institutes missing comparable audit use median 2.45 pp of five available legacy MAEs. This is an imputation, not a measured error.

weightAudit.penaltyRule: For institutes without a historical MAE in the legacy model, use a provisional 5.0 pp denominator in 1/(1+MAE), normalized across all included institutes. This is a disclosed modeling assumption, not measured historical accuracy.
weightAudit.imputationBasis: Median of available five legacy MAEs among currently polled institutes; does not imply actual first-round error.

standardModelBeforeExpansion13.policy: 11 latest national second-round institutes. Five legacy first-round errors unaudited; six errors imputed at 2.45 pp. Shrink all source errors 50% toward median before weighting. No exclusions by result.

weightAudit.imputationBasis: Median of available five legacy MAEs among currently polled institutes; does not imply actual first-round error.
weightAudit.interpretation: Assumed 50% shrinkage, not measured accuracy. Historical errors remain unaudited.

standardModelBeforeExpansion14.policy: 13 latest national second-round polls, one per institute; 7 legacy first-round errors unaudited and 6 imputed at 2.45 pp; 50% shrinkage toward median. Vox Brasil valid-vote split derived from published total-vote percentages.

weightAudit.imputationBasis: Median of available five legacy MAEs among currently polled institutes; does not imply actual first-round error.
weightAudit.interpretation: Assumed 50% shrinkage, not measured accuracy. Historical errors remain unaudited.

standardModelBeforeRecency7.policy: 14 latest national second-round polls, one per institute; 7 legacy first-round errors unaudited and 7 imputed at 2.45 pp; 50% shrinkage toward median.

weightAudit.interpretation: Assumed 50% shrinkage, not measured accuracy. Historical errors remain unaudited.
